context: Daichi shows Sho a fresh fish.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Sho — this fish is really fresh, isn't it.
lines.style: Kansai lilt warm throughout. Opening bright and appreciative. Soft genuine warmth threading the whole thing. Sincere, not performing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Small, quiet voice. Sincere wonder. Soft warmth. Six-year-old genuineness without trying. Brief, genuine smile audible.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 一緒に、本当、頑張った、で。
lines.en: We really worked hard together on this.
lines.style: Kansai warmth throughout. Pride and tenderness mixed. The swing of his accent gentle and proud. Soft glow to the delivery.

lines.style: Small voice, quiet contentment. Genuine warmth. No performance, just a six-year-old stating something true. Slight smile in the tone.
